title: Pandas selection, filtering and assign
summary: Keep transformations explicit and chainable; separate row filters from new-column logic.

blocks.text: Keep transformations explicit and chainable; separate row filters from new-column logic.

items: Prefer vectorized expressions over Python loops for column operations.
assign can make a transformation pipeline readable without mutating intermediate variables.
Check dtypes after ingest because strings and missing values can silently change behavior.
